summary: A ServiceNow connector event trigger became available in preview in Application Integration.
extended_definition: A ServiceNow connector event trigger became available in preview in Application Integration.

supporting_pages.title: ServiceNow trigger \_|\_ Application Integration \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: The following image shows a sample layout of the ServiceNow trigger configuration pane: Trigger output variable For each event, the ServiceNow trigger generates a ConnectorEventPayload output variable which you can use in your downstream tasks.

To configure the ServiceNow trigger , you can either use an existing ServiceNow connection available in Integration Connectors, or create a new ServiceNow connection using the inline connection creation option.

ServiceNow trigger The ServiceNow trigger is a Connector Event trigger that lets you invoke an integration based on the custom ServiceNow events that you've defined in your ServiceNow instance business rule .

supporting_pages.title: Apache Kafka trigger \_|\_ Application Integration \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: To configure the Apache Kafka trigger , you can either use an existing Apache Kafka connection available in Integration Connectors, or create a new Apache Kafka connection using the inline connection creation option.
The Apache Kafka trigger is a Connector Event trigger that lets you invoke an integration based on the Apache Kafka events that you've subscribed to in your Apache Kafka connection.
Note that the Apache Kafka trigger is an Connector Event trigger , therefore you can only use a Apache Kafka connection with event subscription enabled to configure the trigger.
